sources.citation: Griscom, Richard T. 2020. "Our tongues are rare": The mysterious Dorobo language known as Omaiyo. Rift Valley Network Webinar Series, 20 May 2020. 49 slides (PDF on OSF jwqta).
sources.note: Nothing on stress, accent or tone. 'Phonetics and phonology' slides 40-43 give only 'ATR vowels?', a 'Nilotic-ish consonant inventory' chart, and devoicing of voiced fricatives; some cited forms carry tone diacritics (e.g. àjímò 'elephant', sàgérí 'giraffe') without comment.
